name: browser-use
headline: Oblique Strategies - Creative Coding Prompts
short_description: Oblique Strategies plugin for Claude Code provides lateral thinking prompts to break through creative blocks in coding. Benefits developers by introducing new perspectives to problem-solving. Integrates with Claude Code to enhance vibecoding workflows.
author: jakedahn

sections.overview:
Oblique Skills is a Claude Code plugin that brings Brian Eno and Peter Schmidt's Oblique Strategies concept to software development. When you run the /oblique-skills:oblique command, it presents four randomly-selected creative prompts from a deck of 113 original strategies designed to break through mental blocks and introduce unexpected problem-solving angles. You can apply each strategy to your current task, use it as a session-wide mindset, or request an interpretation of how it applies to coding. This tool helps developers approach problems from fresh perspectives and introduces lateral thinking into vibecoding workflows.
Breaking through creative blocks when stuck on a coding problem
Approaching a feature implementation from an unconventional angle
Shifting your coding mindset mid-session to explore new solutions
Reframing and learning from unexpected errors or bugs
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/jakedahn/oblique-skill`
sections.usage:
```
I'm a developer working on a [PROGRAMMING_LANGUAGE] project for [COMPANY]. I'm stuck on [DESCRIBE_PROBLEM]. Can you suggest an oblique strategy to help me approach this differently?
```
Copy

```
# Oblique Strategy for Debugging Challenge
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
